why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 has to FAIL because a build that adds only a padLeft section leaves slugify undocumented, while the request asks for a complete list. I checked the output's line 3 ("README.md has a section for padLeft"). It is marked "FAIL", and its evidence says index.js exports capitalize, slugify and truncate, that the README is "missing" slugify, and that "A PR that adds only a '## padLeft(s, width, fill)' section meets this line, yet the README still leaves out slugify". It ties this to the request's "keep the README's list of functions complete" and proposes a replacement line covering every exported function. The wrong_build field describes the same build. So the one trap is fully caught.
